---
title: "Module 12: Spatial cell-cell communication analysis with CellChat"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-12"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 13 — Spatial CellChat communication analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Perform spatial ligand-receptor communication analysis using CellChat on
#   the final inferCNV + SingleR spatial Seurat object generated in Module 12.
#   Construct a combined CellChat identity in which inferCNV-defined
#   malignant-enriched spots are explicitly labeled "Malignant-enriched"
#   and all remaining spots retain their predominant SingleR identity.
#
#   CellChat is run independently on each spatial slide. The module exports
#   ligand-receptor and pathway-level interactions, examines incoming and
#   outgoing signaling involving malignant-enriched spots, generates network
#   and signaling-role visualizations, merges completed CellChat objects for
#   cross-slide comparison, performs a descriptive comparison of malignant-
#   associated signaling across tumor slides, and saves reusable CellChat
#   objects and an updated spatial Seurat checkpoint.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds
#
# Primary CellChat objects:
#   data/processed/spatial/cellchat/
#     spatial_CellChat_all_samples.rds
#     spatial_CellChat_merged.rds
#
# Per-slide CellChat objects:
#   data/processed/spatial/cellchat/
#     Normal_Tissue_CellChat.rds
#     Vehicle_1_CellChat.rds
#     Vehicle_2_CellChat.rds
#     Niacin_Treatment_CellChat.rds
#
# Updated spatial object:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR_CellChat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/cellchat/
#   results/spatial/cellchat/per_sample/
#   results/spatial/cellchat/cross_slide/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/cellchat/
#   figures/spatial/cellchat/per_sample/
#   figures/spatial/cellchat/cross_slide/
#
# CellChat grouping strategy:
#   Malignant-enriched inferCNV spot -> "Malignant-enriched"
#   All remaining spots             -> predicted_spot_identity
#
# CellChat settings:
#   Assay:              Spatial
#   Database:           CellChatDB.mouse
#   Probability method: triMean
#   Minimum spots/group: 10
#   raw.use:            TRUE
#
# Cross-slide comparison:
#   - Descriptive / exploratory only.
#   - Interaction probabilities are not treatment-level statistical tests.
#   - Niacin-enriched interactions are defined here as:
#       Niacin probability > 0
#       Niacin / mean vehicle probability >= 1.5
#       Niacin probability > mean vehicle probability
#
# Notes:
#   - Visium spots contain mixtures of cells. CellChat identities therefore
#     represent enriched/predominant transcriptional states rather than pure
#     single-cell populations.
#   - CellChat infers potential signaling relationships from expression and
#     prior ligand-receptor knowledge. It does not demonstrate direct binding,
#     receptor activation, cell-cell contact, or causal signaling.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CellChat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_assay <- "Spatial"

sample_column <- "sample"

singleR_column <- "predicted_spot_identity"

malignancy_column <- "malignancy_annotation"

cellchat_group_column <- "CellChat_identity"

malignant_label <- "Malignant-enriched"

minimum_spots_per_group <- 10

normalization_scale_factor <- 10000

communication_method <- "triMean"

niacin_fold_threshold <- 1.5


sample_order <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2",
  "Niacin_Treatment"
)


tumor_samples <- c(
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2",
  "Niacin_Treatment"
)


sample_images <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Naive_A9",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5"
)


sample_titles <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Normal Tissue",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle 1",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle 2",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin Treatment"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

cellchat_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)

per_sample_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat",
  "per_sample"
)

cross_slide_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat",
  "cross_slide"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat"
)

per_sample_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat",
  "per_sample"
)

cross_slide_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cellchat",
  "cross_slide"
)


directories_to_create <- c(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  results_directory,
  per_sample_results_directory,
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  figure_directory,
  per_sample_figure_directory,
  cross_slide_figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define input and output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds"
)

all_cellchat_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_all_samples.rds"
)

merged_cellchat_file <- file.path(
  cellchat_object_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_merged.rds"
)

updated_spatial_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR_CellChat.rds"
)

identity_table_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_spot_identities.csv"
)

summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_summary.csv"
)

malignant_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_malignant_signaling_summary.csv"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_parameters.csv"
)

session_info_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_sessionInfo.txt"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 13 — Spatial CellChat communication analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:         ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:            ", input_file, "\n",
  "CellChat objects:        ", cellchat_object_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory:      ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Per-sample results:      ", per_sample_results_directory, "\n",
  "Cross-slide results:     ", cross_slide_results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:       ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate and load Module 12 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 12 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 12_spatial_singleR.Rmd before Module 13."
  )
}

cat(
  "Loading final inferCNV + SingleR spatial object...\n"
)

spatial_cellchat <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_cellchat, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

available_assays <- names(
  spatial_cellchat@assays
)

if (!cellchat_assay %in% available_assays) {
  stop(
    "Required CellChat assay was not found: ",
    cellchat_assay,
    "\nAvailable assays: ",
    paste(
      available_assays,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_metadata <- c(
  sample_column,
  singleR_column,
  malignancy_column,
  "infercnv_input_group",
  "infercnv_status"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_cellchat@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_cellchat)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spatial spot barcodes were detected."
  )
}

cat(
  "Spatial object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_cellchat), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_cellchat), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Validate samples and spatial images
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

available_samples <- unique(
  as.character(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[sample_column]]
  )
)

missing_samples <- setdiff(
  sample_order,
  available_samples
)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected spatial sample(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

missing_images <- setdiff(
  unname(sample_images),
  Seurat::Images(spatial_cellchat)
)

if (length(missing_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected spatial image(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSpots by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[sample_column]]
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSingleR identities:\n"
)

print(
  sort(
    table(
      spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[singleR_column]],
      useNA = "ifany"
    ),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
)

cat(
  "\nMalignancy annotations:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[malignancy_column]],
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Create combined CellChat identity
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Creating combined SingleR + malignant CellChat identity\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

singleR_identity <- as.character(
  spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[singleR_column]]
)

malignancy_identity <- as.character(
  spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[malignancy_column]]
)

spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity <- dplyr::case_when(
  malignancy_identity == malignant_label ~
    malignant_label,

  is.na(singleR_identity) ~
    "Uncertain",

  singleR_identity == "" ~
    "Uncertain",

  TRUE ~
    singleR_identity
)

spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity <- factor(
  spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
)

cat(
  "\nCombined CellChat identities:\n"
)

print(
  sort(
    table(
      spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity,
      useNA = "ifany"
    ),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
)

cat(
  "\nCellChat identity by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nCellChat identity by malignancy annotation:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[malignancy_column]],
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save CellChat spot-identity table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_identity_table <- data.frame(
  spot = rownames(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data
  ),
  sample = as.character(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[sample_column]]
  ),
  predicted_spot_identity = as.character(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[singleR_column]]
  ),
  malignancy_annotation = as.character(
    spatial_cellchat@meta.data[[malignancy_column]]
  ),
  infercnv_status = as.character(
    spatial_cellchat$infercnv_status
  ),
  CellChat_identity = as.character(
    spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  cellchat_identity_table,
  identity_table_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Create consistent CellChat identity palette
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_identities <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_cellchat$CellChat_identity
    )
  )
)

cellchat_colors <- stats::setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(
    length(cellchat_identities)
  ),
  cellchat_identities
)

if (malignant_label %in% names(cellchat_colors)) {
  cellchat_colors[malignant_label] <- "#D73027"
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Visualize combined CellChat identity spatially
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating spatial CellChat identity maps\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cellchat_spatial_plots <- list()

cellchat_spatial_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in sample_order) {
  image_name <- sample_images[[sample_name]]

  current_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    object = spatial_cellchat,
    images = image_name,
    group.by = cellchat_group_column,
    cols = cellchat_colors,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = sample_titles[[sample_name]]
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  current_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CellChat_identity_spatial.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = current_file,
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )

  cellchat_spatial_plots[[sample_name]] <- current_plot

  cellchat_spatial_files <- c(
    cellchat_spatial_files,
    current_file
  )
}


combined_identity_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  cellchat_spatial_plots,
  ncol = 2,
  guides = "collect"
) &
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

combined_identity_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_CellChat_identity_all_samples.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = combined_identity_file,
  plot = combined_identity_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 600,
  limitsize = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Prepare normalized Spatial expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Preparing normalized Spatial expression for CellChat\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_cellchat
) <- cellchat_assay

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_cellchat[[cellchat_assay]]
)

cat(
  "Spatial assay layers before preparation:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_layers
)

count_layers <- grep(
  "^counts",
  spatial_layers,
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(count_layers) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No raw Spatial count layer was detected."
  )
}

if (length(count_layers) > 1) {
  spatial_cellchat <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_cellchat,
    assay = cellchat_assay
  )
}

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_cellchat[[cellchat_assay]]
)

if (!"data" %in% spatial_layers) {
  cat(
    "Normalized Spatial data layer not found.\n",
    "Running LogNormalize...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_cellchat <- Seurat::NormalizeData(
    object = spatial_cellchat,
    assay = cellchat_assay,
    normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
    scale.factor = normalization_scale_factor,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

if (!"data" %in%
    SeuratObject::Layers(spatial_cellchat[[cellchat_assay]])) {
  stop(
    "Normalized Spatial 'data' layer could not be generated."
  )
}

cat(
  "Normalized Spatial expression is ready.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Load CellChat mouse ligand-receptor database
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CellChatDB_use <- CellChat::CellChatDB.mouse

cat(
  "\nCellChat mouse ligand-receptor interactions: ",
  nrow(CellChatDB_use$interaction),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Define per-slide CellChat function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_spatial_cellchat <- function(
    seurat_object,
    sample_name,
    sample_column,
    group_column,
    assay_name,
    cellchat_database,
    cellchat_object_directory,
    per_sample_results_directory,
    per_sample_figure_directory,
    minimum_spots_per_group,
    communication_method
) {

  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n",
    "Running CellChat — ",
    sample_name,
    "\n",
    "============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  sample_cells <- rownames(
    seurat_object@meta.data
  )[
    seurat_object@meta.data[[sample_column]] ==
      sample_name
  ]

  if (length(sample_cells) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No spots found for sample: ",
      sample_name
    )

    return(NULL)
  }

  sample_object <- subset(
    seurat_object,
    cells = sample_cells
  )

  group_values <- as.character(
    sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
  )

  valid_cells <- colnames(sample_object)[
    !is.na(group_values) &
    group_values != ""
  ]

  sample_object <- subset(
    sample_object,
    cells = valid_cells
  )

  sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]] <- droplevels(
    factor(
      sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
    )
  )

  group_counts <- table(
    sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
  )

  cat(
    "\nInitial CellChat groups:\n"
  )

  print(
    sort(
      group_counts,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove groups below the minimum support threshold
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  groups_to_keep <- names(
    group_counts[
      group_counts >= minimum_spots_per_group
    ]
  )

  groups_removed <- names(
    group_counts[
      group_counts < minimum_spots_per_group
    ]
  )

  if (length(groups_removed) > 0) {
    cat(
      "Removing groups with fewer than ",
      minimum_spots_per_group,
      " spots:\n",
      paste(
        groups_removed,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  keep_cells <- colnames(sample_object)[
    sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]] %in%
      groups_to_keep
  ]

  sample_object <- subset(
    sample_object,
    cells = keep_cells
  )

  sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]] <- droplevels(
    factor(
      sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
    )
  )

  final_group_counts <- table(
    sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
  )

  if (length(final_group_counts) < 2) {
    warning(
      "Fewer than two valid CellChat groups remain for ",
      sample_name,
      ". Skipping sample."
    )

    return(NULL)
  }

  cat(
    "\nFinal CellChat groups:\n"
  )

  print(
    sort(
      final_group_counts,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract normalized expression
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  expression_matrix <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
    object = sample_object,
    assay = assay_name,
    layer = "data"
  )

  expression_matrix <- methods::as(
    expression_matrix,
    "dgCMatrix"
  )

  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[
    ,
    colnames(sample_object),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!identical(
    colnames(expression_matrix),
    colnames(sample_object)
  )) {
    stop(
      "Expression matrix and Seurat spot order do not match for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Create CellChat metadata
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cellchat_metadata <- data.frame(
    cell_type = as.character(
      sample_object@meta.data[[group_column]]
    ),
    row.names = colnames(sample_object),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  cellchat_metadata$cell_type <- factor(
    cellchat_metadata$cell_type
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Create CellChat object
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cellchat <- CellChat::createCellChat(
    object = expression_matrix,
    meta = cellchat_metadata,
    group.by = "cell_type"
  )

  cellchat@DB <- cellchat_database


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Run CellChat inference
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cellchat <- CellChat::subsetData(
    cellchat
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedGenes(
    cellchat,
    do.fast = FALSE
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::identifyOverExpressedInteractions(
    cellchat
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProb(
    cellchat,
    type = communication_method,
    raw.use = TRUE
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::filterCommunication(
    cellchat,
    min.cells = minimum_spots_per_group
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::computeCommunProbPathway(
    cellchat
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::aggregateNet(
    cellchat
  )

  cellchat <- CellChat::netAnalysis_computeCentrality(
    cellchat,
    slot.name = "netP"
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract communication tables
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  communication_table <- as.data.frame(
    CellChat::subsetCommunication(
      cellchat
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  pathway_table <- as.data.frame(
    CellChat::subsetCommunication(
      cellchat,
      slot.name = "netP"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Define sample-level output files
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  interaction_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CellChat_interactions.csv"
    )
  )

  pathway_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CellChat_pathways.csv"
    )
  )

  cell_count_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CellChat_group_counts.csv"
    )
  )

  cellchat_object_file <- file.path(
    cellchat_object_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_CellChat.rds"
    )
  )


  utils::write.csv(
    communication_table,
    interaction_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    pathway_table,
    pathway_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  group_count_table <- data.frame(
    CellChat_identity = names(final_group_counts),
    spots = as.integer(final_group_counts),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    group_count_table,
    cell_count_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract malignant-associated signaling
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  malignant_interaction_file <- NULL
  malignant_outgoing_file <- NULL
  malignant_incoming_file <- NULL

  malignant_interactions <- data.frame()
  malignant_outgoing <- data.frame()
  malignant_incoming <- data.frame()

  if (malignant_label %in% levels(cellchat@idents)) {
    malignant_interactions <- communication_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        source == malignant_label |
        target == malignant_label
      )

    malignant_outgoing <- communication_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        source == malignant_label
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(prob)
      )

    malignant_incoming <- communication_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        target == malignant_label
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(prob)
      )

    malignant_interaction_file <- file.path(
      per_sample_results_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_Malignant_all_interactions.csv"
      )
    )

    malignant_outgoing_file <- file.path(
      per_sample_results_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_Malignant_outgoing_interactions.csv"
      )
    )

    malignant_incoming_file <- file.path(
      per_sample_results_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_Malignant_incoming_interactions.csv"
      )
    )

    utils::write.csv(
      malignant_interactions,
      malignant_interaction_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    utils::write.csv(
      malignant_outgoing,
      malignant_outgoing_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    utils::write.csv(
      malignant_incoming,
      malignant_incoming_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate interaction-number circle plot
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  group_size <- as.numeric(
    table(
      cellchat@idents
    )
  )

  interaction_number_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_interaction_number_circle.pdf"
    )
  )

  grDevices::pdf(
    interaction_number_file,
    width = 9,
    height = 9
  )

  CellChat::netVisual_circle(
    cellchat@net$count,
    vertex.weight = group_size,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    label.edge = FALSE,
    title.name = paste0(
      sample_name,
      " — Number of interactions"
    )
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate interaction-strength circle plot
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  interaction_strength_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_interaction_strength_circle.pdf"
    )
  )

  grDevices::pdf(
    interaction_strength_file,
    width = 9,
    height = 9
  )

  CellChat::netVisual_circle(
    cellchat@net$weight,
    vertex.weight = group_size,
    weight.scale = TRUE,
    label.edge = FALSE,
    title.name = paste0(
      sample_name,
      " — Interaction strength"
    )
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate outgoing signaling-role heatmap
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  outgoing_heatmap_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_outgoing_signaling_heatmap.pdf"
    )
  )

  grDevices::pdf(
    outgoing_heatmap_file,
    width = 11,
    height = 9
  )

  print(
    CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
      cellchat,
      pattern = "outgoing"
    )
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate incoming signaling-role heatmap
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  incoming_heatmap_file <- file.path(
    per_sample_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_incoming_signaling_heatmap.pdf"
    )
  )

  grDevices::pdf(
    incoming_heatmap_file,
    width = 11,
    height = 9
  )

  print(
    CellChat::netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
      cellchat,
      pattern = "incoming"
    )
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate malignant-focused bubble plots
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  malignant_outgoing_bubble_file <- NULL
  malignant_incoming_bubble_file <- NULL

  if (malignant_label %in% levels(cellchat@idents)) {
    all_groups <- levels(
      cellchat@idents
    )

    malignant_index <- which(
      all_groups == malignant_label
    )

    non_malignant_indices <- which(
      all_groups != malignant_label
    )

    if (length(non_malignant_indices) > 0) {
      malignant_outgoing_bubble_file <- file.path(
        per_sample_figure_directory,
        paste0(
          sample_name,
          "_Malignant_outgoing_bubble.pdf"
        )
      )

      grDevices::pdf(
        malignant_outgoing_bubble_file,
        width = 12,
        height = 9
      )

      print(
        CellChat::netVisual_bubble(
          cellchat,
          sources.use = malignant_index,
          targets.use = non_malignant_indices,
          remove.isolate = FALSE
        )
      )

      grDevices::dev.off()


      malignant_incoming_bubble_file <- file.path(
        per_sample_figure_directory,
        paste0(
          sample_name,
          "_Malignant_incoming_bubble.pdf"
        )
      )

      grDevices::pdf(
        malignant_incoming_bubble_file,
        width = 12,
        height = 9
      )

      print(
        CellChat::netVisual_bubble(
          cellchat,
          sources.use = non_malignant_indices,
          targets.use = malignant_index,
          remove.isolate = FALSE
        )
      )

      grDevices::dev.off()
    }
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save completed CellChat object
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  saveRDS(
    object = cellchat,
    file = cellchat_object_file,
    compress = TRUE
  )

  if (!file.exists(cellchat_object_file)) {
    stop(
      "CellChat object was not saved for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }


  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return result information
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------

  return(
    list(
      cellchat = cellchat,
      sample_name = sample_name,
      spots_analyzed = ncol(sample_object),
      groups = length(final_group_counts),
      group_counts = final_group_counts,
      communication_table = communication_table,
      pathway_table = pathway_table,
      malignant_interactions = malignant_interactions,
      malignant_outgoing = malignant_outgoing,
      malignant_incoming = malignant_incoming,
      object_file = cellchat_object_file,
      interaction_file = interaction_file,
      pathway_file = pathway_file,
      cell_count_file = cell_count_file,
      malignant_interaction_file = malignant_interaction_file,
      malignant_outgoing_file = malignant_outgoing_file,
      malignant_incoming_file = malignant_incoming_file,
      interaction_number_file = interaction_number_file,
      interaction_strength_file = interaction_strength_file,
      outgoing_heatmap_file = outgoing_heatmap_file,
      incoming_heatmap_file = incoming_heatmap_file,
      malignant_outgoing_bubble_file = malignant_outgoing_bubble_file,
      malignant_incoming_bubble_file = malignant_incoming_bubble_file
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Run CellChat independently across spatial slides
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Running per-slide spatial CellChat analyses\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

CellChat_results <- list()

for (current_sample in sample_order) {

    cellchat_object_directory = cellchat_object_directory,
    per_sample_results_directory = per_sample_results_directory,
    per_sample_figure_directory = per_sample_figure_directory,
    minimum_spots_per_group = minimum_spots_per_group,
    communication_method = communication_method
  )
}

CellChat_results <- CellChat_results[

    CellChat_results,

}

)

)

saveRDS(

)

#==============================================================================
# CROSS-SLIDE MALIGNANT SIGNALING ANALYSIS

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Extract and clean communication tables
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Cross-slide malignant signaling analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

communication_tables <- list()

for (sample_name in names(CellChat_results)) {
  current_table <- CellChat_results[[sample_name]]$communication_table

  current_table <- as.data.frame(
    current_table,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(current_table) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No significant CellChat interactions detected for ",
      sample_name
    )

    next
  }

  character_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "source",
      "target",
      "ligand",
      "receptor",
      "interaction_name",
      "interaction_name_2",
      "pathway_name",
      "annotation",
      "evidence"
    ),
    colnames(current_table)
  )

  for (current_column in character_columns) {
    current_table[[current_column]] <- as.character(
      unlist(
        current_table[[current_column]],
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if ("prob" %in% colnames(current_table)) {
    current_table$prob <- as.numeric(
      unlist(
        current_table$prob,
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  current_table$sample <- sample_name

  current_table$interaction_key <- paste(
    current_table$source,
    current_table$target,
    current_table$ligand,
    current_table$receptor,
    sep = " | "
  )

  current_table$lr_key <- paste(
    current_table$ligand,
    current_table$receptor,
    sep = " -> "
  )

  communication_tables[[sample_name]] <- current_table
}

if (length(communication_tables) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No CellChat communication tables were successfully extracted."
  )
}

all_interactions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  communication_tables
)

all_interactions_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "all_CellChat_interactions_cleaned.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  all_interactions,
  all_interactions_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Extract malignant-associated interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tumor_interactions <- all_interactions[
  all_interactions$sample %in% tumor_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

malignant_interactions <- tumor_interactions[
  tumor_interactions$source == malignant_label |
  tumor_interactions$target == malignant_label,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

malignant_outgoing <- malignant_interactions[
  malignant_interactions$source == malignant_label,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

malignant_incoming <- malignant_interactions[
  malignant_interactions$target == malignant_label,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat(
  "\nMalignant-associated interactions by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    malignant_interactions$sample,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

all_malignant_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "all_malignant_associated_interactions.csv"
)

all_malignant_outgoing_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "all_malignant_outgoing_interactions.csv"
)

all_malignant_incoming_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "all_malignant_incoming_interactions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  malignant_interactions,
  all_malignant_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  malignant_outgoing,

  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  malignant_incoming,
  all_malignant_incoming_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Identify malignant interactions unique to each tumor slide
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

vehicle1_keys <- unique(
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key[
    malignant_interactions$sample == "Vehicle_1"
  ]
)

vehicle2_keys <- unique(
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key[
    malignant_interactions$sample == "Vehicle_2"
  ]
)

niacin_keys <- unique(
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key[
    malignant_interactions$sample == "Niacin_Treatment"
  ]
)

vehicle1_unique_keys <- setdiff(
  vehicle1_keys,
  union(
    vehicle2_keys,
    niacin_keys
  )
)

vehicle2_unique_keys <- setdiff(
  vehicle2_keys,
  union(
    vehicle1_keys,
    niacin_keys
  )
)

niacin_unique_keys <- setdiff(
  niacin_keys,
  union(
    vehicle1_keys,
    vehicle2_keys
  )
)

vehicle1_unique <- malignant_interactions[
  malignant_interactions$sample == "Vehicle_1" &
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key %in%
    vehicle1_unique_keys,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

vehicle2_unique <- malignant_interactions[
  malignant_interactions$sample == "Vehicle_2" &
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key %in%
    vehicle2_unique_keys,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_unique <- malignant_interactions[
  malignant_interactions$sample == "Niacin_Treatment" &
  malignant_interactions$interaction_key %in%
    niacin_unique_keys,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

vehicle1_unique <- vehicle1_unique[
  order(
    vehicle1_unique$prob,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

vehicle2_unique <- vehicle2_unique[
  order(
    vehicle2_unique$prob,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_unique <- niacin_unique[
  order(
    niacin_unique$prob,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

vehicle1_unique_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Vehicle_1_unique_malignant_interactions.csv"
)

vehicle2_unique_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Vehicle_2_unique_malignant_interactions.csv"
)

niacin_unique_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Niacin_unique_malignant_interactions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  vehicle1_unique,
  vehicle1_unique_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  vehicle2_unique,
  vehicle2_unique_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  niacin_unique,
  niacin_unique_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nUnique malignant-associated interactions:\n",
  "  Vehicle 1: ", nrow(vehicle1_unique), "\n",
  "  Vehicle 2: ", nrow(vehicle2_unique), "\n",
  "  Niacin:    ", nrow(niacin_unique), "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Compare Niacin malignant signals with mean vehicle signal
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_probability_columns <- c(
  "sample",
  "interaction_key",
  "source",
  "target",
  "ligand",
  "receptor",
  "pathway_name",
  "prob"
)

missing_probability_columns <- setdiff(
  required_probability_columns,
  colnames(malignant_interactions)
)

if (length(missing_probability_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required CellChat interaction column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_probability_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

malignant_probability_table <- malignant_interactions %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(
      required_probability_columns
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    interaction_key,
    source,
    target,
    ligand,
    receptor,
    pathway_name
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    prob = max(
      prob,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interaction_metadata <- malignant_probability_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    interaction_key,
    source,
    target,
    ligand,
    receptor,
    pathway_name
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

malignant_probability_wide <- malignant_probability_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    interaction_key,
    prob
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = prob,
    values_fill = 0
  )

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  if (!sample_name %in%
      colnames(malignant_probability_wide)) {
    malignant_probability_wide[[sample_name]] <- 0
  }
}

niacin_vs_vehicle <- malignant_probability_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Vehicle_mean =
      (Vehicle_1 + Vehicle_2) / 2,

    Niacin_minus_vehicle =
      Niacin_Treatment - Vehicle_mean,

    Niacin_fold_vs_vehicle =
      (Niacin_Treatment + 1e-10) /
      (Vehicle_mean + 1e-10)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    interaction_metadata,
    by = "interaction_key"
  )

niacin_enriched <- niacin_vs_vehicle %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Niacin_Treatment > 0,
    Niacin_fold_vs_vehicle >= niacin_fold_threshold,
    Niacin_minus_vehicle > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      Niacin_minus_vehicle
    )
  )

niacin_vs_vehicle_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Niacin_vs_vehicle_all_malignant_interactions.csv"
)

niacin_enriched_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Niacin_enriched_malignant_interactions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  niacin_vs_vehicle,
  niacin_vs_vehicle_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  niacin_enriched,
  niacin_enriched_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nNiacin-enriched malignant interactions: ",
  nrow(niacin_enriched),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Rank TME populations receiving malignant signals
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

malignant_target_summary <- malignant_outgoing %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    target
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_interactions = dplyr::n(),
    total_probability = sum(
      prob,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_probability = mean(
      prob,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

malignant_target_summary_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "malignant_outgoing_TME_target_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  malignant_target_summary,
  malignant_target_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

malignant_target_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  malignant_target_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = reorder(
      target,
      total_probability
    ),
    y = total_probability,
    fill = sample
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "TME Targets of Malignant-Enriched Signaling",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total inferred interaction probability",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  )

malignant_target_plot_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_figure_directory,
  "malignant_outgoing_TME_targets.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = malignant_target_plot_file,
  plot = malignant_target_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Summarize malignant-associated signaling pathways
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

malignant_pathway_summary <- data.frame()

niacin_unique_pathways <- data.frame()

malignant_pathway_summary_file <- NULL

niacin_unique_pathway_file <- NULL

malignant_pathway_plot_file <- NULL

if ("pathway_name" %in%
    colnames(malignant_interactions)) {

  malignant_pathway_summary <- malignant_interactions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(pathway_name),
      pathway_name != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      sample,
      pathway_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_interactions = dplyr::n(),
      total_probability = sum(
        prob,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  malignant_pathway_summary_file <- file.path(
    cross_slide_results_directory,
    "malignant_pathway_summary.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    malignant_pathway_summary,
    malignant_pathway_summary_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  vehicle1_pathways <- unique(
    malignant_pathway_summary$pathway_name[
      malignant_pathway_summary$sample ==
        "Vehicle_1"
    ]
  )

  vehicle2_pathways <- unique(
    malignant_pathway_summary$pathway_name[
      malignant_pathway_summary$sample ==
        "Vehicle_2"
    ]
  )

  niacin_pathways <- malignant_pathway_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      sample == "Niacin_Treatment"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        total_probability
      )
    )

  niacin_pathway_names <- unique(
    niacin_pathways$pathway_name
  )

  niacin_unique_pathway_names <- setdiff(
    niacin_pathway_names,
    union(
      vehicle1_pathways,
      vehicle2_pathways
    )
  )

  niacin_unique_pathways <- niacin_pathways %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      pathway_name %in%
        niacin_unique_pathway_names
    )

  niacin_unique_pathway_file <- file.path(
    cross_slide_results_directory,
    "Niacin_unique_malignant_pathways.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    niacin_unique_pathways,
    niacin_unique_pathway_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  top_pathways <- malignant_pathway_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      pathway_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total = sum(
        total_probability,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(total)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n = 15
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      pathway_name
    )

  malignant_pathway_plot_data <-
    malignant_pathway_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      pathway_name %in%
        top_pathways
    )

  malignant_pathway_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    malignant_pathway_plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = pathway_name,
      y = total_probability,
      fill = sample
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position = "dodge"
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Malignant-Associated Signaling Pathways",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Total inferred interaction probability",
      fill = "Sample"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    )

  malignant_pathway_plot_file <- file.path(
    cross_slide_figure_directory,
    "malignant_pathways_cross_slide.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = malignant_pathway_plot_file,
    plot = malignant_pathway_plot,
    width = 11,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Extract Niacin-specific malignant outgoing and incoming interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

niacin_specific_outgoing <- niacin_unique[
  niacin_unique$source == malignant_label,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_specific_incoming <- niacin_unique[
  niacin_unique$target == malignant_label,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_specific_outgoing <- niacin_specific_outgoing[
  order(
    niacin_specific_outgoing$prob,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_specific_incoming <- niacin_specific_incoming[
  order(
    niacin_specific_incoming$prob,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

niacin_specific_outgoing_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Niacin_unique_malignant_OUTGOING.csv"
)

niacin_specific_incoming_file <- file.path(
  cross_slide_results_directory,
  "Niacin_unique_malignant_INCOMING.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  niacin_specific_outgoing,
  niacin_specific_outgoing_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  niacin_specific_incoming,
  niacin_specific_incoming_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Identify globally unique Niacin interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

niacin_global_unique <- data.frame()

niacin_global_unique_file <- NULL

if (
  "Normal_Tissue" %in% names(communication_tables) &&
  "Vehicle_1" %in% names(communication_tables) &&
  "Vehicle_2" %in% names(communication_tables) &&
  "Niacin_Treatment" %in% names(communication_tables)
) {

  niacin_global_keys <- unique(
    communication_tables[["Niacin_Treatment"]]$interaction_key
  )

  comparison_global_keys <- unique(
    c(
      communication_tables[["Vehicle_1"]]$interaction_key,
      communication_tables[["Vehicle_2"]]$interaction_key,
      communication_tables[["Normal_Tissue"]]$interaction_key
    )
  )

  niacin_global_unique_keys <- setdiff(
    niacin_global_keys,
    comparison_global_keys
  )

  niacin_global_unique <-
    communication_tables[["Niacin_Treatment"]][
      communication_tables[["Niacin_Treatment"]]$interaction_key %in%
      niacin_global_unique_keys,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  niacin_global_unique <- niacin_global_unique[
    order(
      niacin_global_unique$prob,
      decreasing = TRUE
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  niacin_global_unique_file <- file.path(
    cross_slide_results_directory,
    "Niacin_unique_vs_vehicle_and_normal_all_interactions.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    niacin_global_unique,
    niacin_global_unique_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Plot top Niacin-enriched malignant interactions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

niacin_enriched_plot_file <- NULL

top_niacin_enriched <- niacin_enriched %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(
    n = 20
  )

if (nrow(top_niacin_enriched) > 0) {
  top_niacin_enriched$interaction_label <- paste0(
    top_niacin_enriched$ligand,
    " -> ",
    top_niacin_enriched$receptor,
    "\n",
    top_niacin_enriched$source,
    " -> ",
    top_niacin_enriched$target
  )

  niacin_enriched_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    top_niacin_enriched,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = reorder(
        interaction_label,
        Niacin_fold_vs_vehicle
      ),
      y = Niacin_fold_vs_vehicle
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = niacin_fold_threshold,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Niacin-Enriched Malignant-Associated Interactions",
      subtitle =
        "Relative to mean Vehicle 1 / Vehicle 2 CellChat probability",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Niacin / mean vehicle interaction probability"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    )

  niacin_enriched_plot_file <- file.path(
    cross_slide_figure_directory,
    "Niacin_enriched_malignant_interactions.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = niacin_enriched_plot_file,
    plot = niacin_enriched_plot,
    width = 11,
    height = 9,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Save CellChat identity into master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving CellChat identity into master spatial object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

saveRDS(
  object = spatial_cellchat,
  file = updated_spatial_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(updated_spatial_file)) {
  stop(
    "Updated CellChat-annotated spatial object was not saved."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Save analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cellchat_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "cellchat_assay",
    "sample_column",
    "SingleR_column",
    "malignancy_column",
    "CellChat_group_column",
    "malignant_label",
    "database",
    "communication_method",
    "minimum_spots_per_group",
    "raw_use",
    "normalization_method",
    "normalization_scale_factor",
    "niacin_fold_threshold"
  ),
  value = c(
    cellchat_assay,
    sample_column,
    singleR_column,
    malignancy_column,
    cellchat_group_column,
    malignant_label,
    "CellChatDB.mouse",
    communication_method,
    minimum_spots_per_group,
    TRUE,
    "LogNormalize",
    normalization_scale_factor,
    niacin_fold_threshold
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  cellchat_parameters,
  parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Save session information
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

writeLines(
  capture.output(
    sessionInfo()
  ),
  con = session_info_file
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Validate expected Module 13 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  all_cellchat_file,
  updated_spatial_file,
  vapply(
    CellChat_results,
    function(x) x$object_file,
    character(1)
  )
)

if (!is.null(cellchat_merged)) {
  expected_object_files <- c(
    expected_object_files,
    merged_cellchat_file
  )
}


expected_result_files <- c(
  identity_table_file,
  summary_file,
  malignant_summary_file,
  parameter_file,
  session_info_file,
  all_interactions_file,
  all_malignant_file,
  all_malignant_outgoing_file,
  all_malignant_incoming_file,
  vehicle1_unique_file,
  vehicle2_unique_file,
  niacin_unique_file,
  niacin_vs_vehicle_file,
  niacin_enriched_file,
  malignant_target_summary_file,
  niacin_specific_outgoing_file,
  niacin_specific_incoming_file
)

per_sample_result_files <- unlist(
  lapply(
    CellChat_results,
    function(x) {
      c(
        x$interaction_file,
        x$pathway_file,
        x$cell_count_file,
        x$malignant_interaction_file,
        x$malignant_outgoing_file,
        x$malignant_incoming_file
      )
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

per_sample_result_files <- per_sample_result_files[
  !is.na(per_sample_result_files) &
  per_sample_result_files != ""
]

expected_result_files <- c(
  expected_result_files,
  per_sample_result_files
)

if (!is.null(malignant_pathway_summary_file)) {
  expected_result_files <- c(
    expected_result_files,
    malignant_pathway_summary_file,
    niacin_unique_pathway_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(niacin_global_unique_file)) {
  expected_result_files <- c(
    expected_result_files,
    niacin_global_unique_file
  )
}


expected_figure_files <- c(
  cellchat_spatial_files,
  combined_identity_file,
  malignant_summary_plot_file,
  malignant_target_plot_file
)

per_sample_figure_files <- unlist(
  lapply(
    CellChat_results,
    function(x) {
      c(
        x$interaction_number_file,
        x$interaction_strength_file,
        x$outgoing_heatmap_file,
        x$incoming_heatmap_file,
        x$malignant_outgoing_bubble_file,
        x$malignant_incoming_bubble_file
      )
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

per_sample_figure_files <- per_sample_figure_files[
  !is.na(per_sample_figure_files) &
  per_sample_figure_files != ""
]

expected_figure_files <- c(
  expected_figure_files,
  per_sample_figure_files
)

if (!is.null(interaction_number_comparison_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    interaction_number_comparison_file,
    interaction_strength_comparison_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(malignant_pathway_plot_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(

  )
}

if (!is.null(niacin_enriched_plot_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,

  )
}


missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(expected_object_files)
]

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[

]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[

]


if (length(missing_object_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 13 object files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_object_files,
      collapse = "\n"

}

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {

    "One or more expected Module 13 result files were not created:\n",

      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )

}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {

    paste(
      missing_figure_files,

    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 13 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)

)
```
